summary: register_secret registers a string with Ansible's secret masker so it is redacted from display output and module logging, returning the value unchanged; non-string values raise an error.
questions: How do I make Ansible mask a value I fetched from an environment variable?
Can I register a non-string value as a secret?

answer_card.title: register_secret filter
answer_card.answer_md: `register_secret` registers the input with Ansible's secret masker so it's redacted from masked output such as display output and module logging. It's non-destructive: the value is returned **unchanged**, so you can register it inline while assigning it. Only **strings** can be registered; other types raise an error.
